nodes.name: ReadNotice
nodes.role: read the landlord notice file the user names

nodes.name: ExtractChanges
nodes.role: list each rent standing order field the notice asks to change, with its current and proposed value

nodes.name: VerifyLandlord
nodes.role: check that the notice's sender matches the landlord and payee on record for the rent standing order

nodes.name: ConfirmWithUser
nodes.role: show the user the proposed changes and obtain their explicit approval before any change is made

nodes.name: UpdateStandingOrder
nodes.role: apply the approved changes to the rent standing order

nodes.name: ReportResult
nodes.role: tell the user which fields changed, their new values, and any change that was skipped or rejected
